entities.summary: Preston Demarquis Smith is an American professional football linebacker. He played college football for the Mississippi State Bulldogs and was selected by the Washington Redskins in the second round of the 2015 NFL draft. Smith has also been a member of the Green Bay Packers and Pittsburgh Steelers.
